author: dnsnakmw

title: Free 5 habits!
body: Im using the free version and this is the only app that has offered 5 habits even in the free version! Everything is perfect and minimalist! But I’d love to see the annual habits track too which is the only significant thing i see missing in the app. Thank you! I think i might upgrade this into premium soon! Thank you again!
author: Harindu Fdoe

title: Good app
body: It’s a nice app. The UI could be modernized more. Feels a little laggy sometimes.
